values: Good Day, Everyone! Welcome to Tutor LMS Academy, an all-new series to learn the ins and outs of Tutor LMS. Get essential insights into its nitty-gritty and make your site all the more powerful. We cannot wait to go on this journey with you all. Have a good one!
How to Install & Activate License in Tutor LMS

Learn how easily you can install Tutor LMS free and pro, and activate the license to get all the benefits of the premium plugin in your future endeavours. Follow the step by step guide to get started.
How to create an online course on WordPress with Tutor LMS
Take an in depth look at the backend course builder of Tutor LMS. We walk through the options of the Tutor LMS backend course builder and show you how to figure out the various options.
Join us for an overview of the General Settings of Tutor LMS. We go through what the different setting options mean for anyone facing trouble with it.
Learn the uses of the individual options in the Course Settings of Tutor LMS. We walkthrough each of the options and explain what the settings are meant to do.
Learn the uses of the individual options in the Design Settings of Tutor LMS and have a look at how they impact the frontend view of your eLearning site.
Let’s take a look at the Monetization settings of Tutor LMS that allows admins to control the money flow in an eLearning platform and sell online courses easily!
The Advanced settings of Tutor LMS help tweak the intricate details of our LMS. Watch the explanation on the individual settings of the Advanced settings to better utilise your favourite Tutor LMS.
Learn about the Email Settings of Tutor LMS and how you can utilize the Email Template Editor to power up your eLearning site.

Take a look at the wonderful Certificate Builder of Tutor LMS. We show in this tutorial how you can get it installed and activated on Tutor LMS, also going over how the options in Certificate Builder function.
Learn how to navigate the Notifications and the Gradebook Settings of Tutor LMS in this short overview. Find out how to turn on notifications and utilise grade systems for your eLearning site.
How to create a paid course on WordPress with Tutor LMS
In this quick tutorial, take a look at a very important task in the course-building process which is how to make a course paid in Tutor LMS using WooCommerce.
How to Migrate from LearnDash to Tutor LMS
Find out to migrate to Tutor LMS from other LMSs with just a click of a button. Use the powerful Tutor LMS Migration Tool to switch over to Tutor LMS in just a moment.
How to create an online course using Tutor LMS Frontend Course Builder

The Frontend Course Builder is one of the most highlighted features of Tutor LMS with its amazing UI and ease of use. In this video, find out how to make a course from scratch in the beautiful Frontend Course Builder.
How to Drip Feed an online course using Tutor LMS
Drip-Feed encourages better student engagement and automates the process of course scheduling. Tutor LMS makes the process of drip-feeding your course content uniquely easy!
How to Get Important Analytics Using Tutor LMS Reports Add-on
Tutor LMS provides the right analytics tools to make data-driven decisions to better our LMS courses. Learn how to use Tutor LMS analytics to evaluate how your business is performing.
How To Integrate Google Meet With Tutor LMS
Tutor LMS has a wonderful integration with Google Meet. From creating Google credentials to setting up Google Meet with Tutor LMS, follow our step-by-step tutorial to go through the process.
Tutor LMS has introduced authentication with enhanced security features for users. The settings allow instructors and admins to protect their eLearning platforms from spammers and fraud.
How To Enable Google Social Login For Tutor LMS
This tutorial is all about how you can get the Google Social Login key for Tutor LMS social login feature.
How to Migrate from Zoom JWT App to Server-To-Server oAuth App
This tutorial is all about the workarounds on how to switch from Zoom JWT to Server-To-Server oAuth app system as Zoom has recently deprecated the JWT integration method.
How To Get Facebook App ID For Tutor LMS Social Login
Social Login is an important feature in Tutor LMS. In this tutorial, we will learn how we can get the Facebook App ID for Tutor LMS social login with Facebook.
How to Easily Create Course Bundles in Tutor LMS
We'll guide you through the process of effortlessly creating course bundles, adjusting prices with or without promotions, and getting your bundle ready for publication.
How to Fraud Protect Your Tutor LMS Site with Google reCAPTCHA
This video is a how to guide on reCAPTCHA key generation to use fraud protection on your Tutor LMS site.
Migrate From LifterLMS to Tutor LMS
Discover the quick and easy way to migrate from LifterLMS to Tutor LMS. Dive into the Lifter LMS Migration Tool and explore the choice between auto-migration and manual migration.
Migrate from LearnPress to Tutor LMS
Discover the quick and easy way to migrate from LearnPress to Tutor LMS. Dive into the LearnPress Migration Tool and explore auto-migration and manual migration by uploading XML file.
Tutor LMS Assignment & Grading System Setup

Effectively managing student progress through assignment creation and grading is a crucial aspect of any LMS. We guide you through the process of creating assignments and establishing a seamless grading system.
How To Compose Manual Email With Tutor LMS
This tutorial is all about the Manual Email Template Builder in Tutor LMS. This tool will help you to build your desired email template from scratch.
Setup Google Client ID for Social Login in Tutor LMS
This tutorial provides comprehensive guidance on obtaining the Google social login key required for the Tutor LMS social login feature. Updated version with latest instructions.
How to integrate Google Classroom with Tutor LMS
Check out our tutorial on how to integrate Google Classroom with Tutor LMS, elevating your eLearning platform. From creating Google credentials to setting up the integration.
How to Install and Activate License for Tutor LMS Pro
With the dawn of the new site we wanted to do a refresher for the installation and activation process for Tutor LMS Pro.
How to Navigate the All New Course Builder in Tutor LMS
Watch how to Navigate the All-New Course Builder in Tutor LMS 3.0! Follow along as we go over the course builder and how things work.
How to Set Up the Native eCommerce in Tutor LMS
Unlock the full potential of your eLearning platform with Tutor LMS's native eCommerce! We'll guide you through setting up the integrated eCommerce system, creating coupons, and managing orders.
How to Integrate Stripe Payment Gateway in Tutor LMS
Learn how to seamlessly integrate Stripe as a payment gateway in Tutor LMS. This step-by-step tutorial covers adding Stripe, configuring API keys, setting up the webhook.
How to Integrate PayPal Payment Gateway with Tutor LMS
We'll walk you through the step-by-step process of integrating PayPal as a payment gateway with Tutor LMS's native eCommerce system.
Recurring Payments with Subscriptions & Memberships in Tutor LMS
We'll guide you through the all-new native recurring payment feature in Tutor LMS. Creating subscriptions for individual courses, course bundles, full-site access, and specific categories.
Course Scheduling and Enrollment Options in Tutor LMS
We'll explore the powerful enrollment options and course scheduling in Tutor LMS Pro, which give you granular control over how students sign up for your courses.
How to Import/Export Courses in Tutor LMS
We walk you through the Import & Export feature in Tutor LMS Pro — a powerful tool to help you transfer courses, bundles, lessons, quizzes, and settings between sites.
How to Use the Content Bank in Tutor LMS
The Content Bank lets you store and reuse lessons, quizzes, and assignments across multiple courses. Create once, use anywhere.
